title: 第9章 一切皆正常第10章 龟兹舞女动春殿
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
龙藏术运转至极致，夏无恙的躯体以肉眼可见的速度衰败下去。
原本还有几分血色的面容重新变得灰败枯槁，皮肤上浮现出大片老年斑，连呼吸都变得时断时续，仿佛下一刻就会咽气。
藏在锦被下的手指微微蜷曲，一根幽冥绝脉针已悄然夹在指间。
若那鬼影稍有异动，即便拼着经脉尽断，也要催动全身气血发出致命一击。
“沙……”
似有若无的微风在文华殿中徜徉，一道近乎虚幻的鬼影出现在寝殿之中，嗅闻了一下空气中弥漫的香料，脸上划过一抹讥嘲之色。
就连睡觉都需要靠助眠的香料，看来这垂暮太子的身体越来越差了，距离死亡已然不远。
不过还是不能放松警惕，无声无息来到夏无恙面前，右手微微轻抚，让香料的味道越发浓郁，确认夏无恙已经沉睡不醒，这才开始检查起来。
体魄……无异常，越来越差了！
皮膜……无异常，越来越松软！
肌肉……无异常，越来越无力！
……
鬼影检查得很仔细，一分一毫都没有放过，但凡发现有什么异常的地方，就会告诉身后之人，对夏无恙进行下一步的动作。
他的实力很强，在夏无恙的感知中宛若炽热的火焰，这还是在其有意收敛隐藏的情况下。
若是不出意外的话，鬼影至少也是四品之境的武者，甚至有可能已经晋升上三品，远远地胜过了此刻的夏无恙。
就算是与其拼命，死的也会是夏无恙，那种无力的感觉，委实让人绝望。
好在鬼影对他并没有歹心，只是在观察他的身体情况，确认他并没有隐藏，避免夏无恙扮猪吃虎。
若非已经将龙藏术修行大成，这次他绝对躲不过去，很快等待着他的就是雷霆一击，甚至是致命的杀手。
半个时辰后，鬼影这才停手，满意地点了点头，喃喃低语：“跟三个月前并无区别，身体状况未曾好转，反而越来越差，也没有隐藏什么，快则几个月，慢则一年半载，这老东西必死无疑，可以回去汇报给主子了。”
话语落下，鬼影无声无息消失在文华殿，但是躺在床上的夏无恙仍旧一动不动，就像是睡死了过去。

窗外传来三更梆子声，夏无恙缓缓松开攥紧的拳头，掌心四个月牙形的血痕触目惊心。
这场生死一线的试探，终究是他险胜半子。
瞳孔深处，一抹寒光悄然浮现，根据鬼影留下的低语，他隐隐猜测那个幕后之人，应该就是有资格继承太子之位的几个弟弟，老二、老六、还是老九……夏无恙不得而知。
他现在实力低微，没有几个可用之人，甚至都不知道谁能够信赖，怎么查得到背后之人。
唯一能够做的，就是不断地提升修为境界，直到拥有颠覆一切的力量，这才能够了解真相，找到幕后凶手。
每天增加一点精神力量，连带着其它属性也会不断增长，按照这样的速度，要不了多长时间，他就能够做到如此。
快了，已经快了！
夏无恙嘴角有冷笑划过，抱着新召入的宫女青黛尽情怜惜，继续做一个昏聩无能、夜夜笙歌的垂暮太子。
锦帐流苏坠宝珰，葡萄美酒映唇香。
美人解语花解笑，谁管今宵漏刻长。
他已然沉浸其中，周围美人如玉，歌舞升平，仿佛不知道白天黑夜。
周围都是一些不通修行的宫女，丝毫没有察觉到，在这具苍老枯槁的身体下面，龙虎气血正在疯狂运转。
经过他的改良，契合他的身体以后，即使不用龙虎桩功，他也能够不断提升修为境界，其他人就无法如此。
content_en:
The Long Zang Technique was operating at its peak, and Xia Wuyan's body was decaying at a speed visible to the naked eye.
His face, which was still a little bloody, turned gray and withered again, large age spots appeared on his skin, and even his breathing became intermittent, as if he would die in the next moment.
The fingers hidden under the brocade quilt were slightly curled, and a Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle was quietly clamped between the fingers.
If the ghostly figure makes any slight movement, even if all the meridians are cut off, the energy and blood in the whole body will be mobilized to deliver a fatal blow.
"Sand..."
A faint breeze lingered in the Wenhua Palace, and an almost illusory ghost appeared in the dormitory. After sniffing the spices in the air, a mocking look flashed across his face.
Even sleeping requires the help of sleeping spices. It seems that the health of the dying prince is getting worse and worse, and death is not far away.
However, he still couldn't relax his vigilance. He came to Xia Wuyang silently and gently touched him with his right hand, making the smell of spices stronger. After confirming that Xia Wuyang was asleep and unconscious, he began to check.
Physical fitness...nothing abnormal, just getting worse and worse!
The skin film...no abnormalities, getting softer and softer!
Muscles...no abnormalities, just getting weaker and weaker!
…
The ghost checked very carefully, not missing a single point. If he found anything abnormal, he would tell the people behind him to take the next step towards Xia Wuyang.
His strength was very strong, like a blazing flame in Xia Wuyan's perception, and this was despite his deliberate efforts to hide it.
If nothing else, Guiying is at least a fourth-grade warrior, and may even have been promoted to third-grade, far surpassing Xia Wuyan at this moment.
Even if he had tried his best, Xia Wuyang would have died. That feeling of powerlessness was truly despairing.
Fortunately, Guiying had no evil intentions towards him. He was just observing his physical condition to make sure that he was not hiding, so as to prevent Xia Wuyang from pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger.
If he had not mastered the Dragon Hidden Technique, he would never have been able to escape this time. What was waiting for him soon was a thunderous strike, or even a fatal killer.
After half an hour, the ghost stopped, nodded with satisfaction, and murmured: "There is no difference from three months ago. His physical condition has not improved, but is getting worse. There is nothing to hide. It could be a few months at the earliest, or a year and a half at the earliest. This old guy will definitely die. He can go back and report to the master."
After the words fell, the ghost disappeared silently in the Wenhua Palace, but Xia Wuyang, who was lying on the bed, remained motionless, as if he had fallen asleep.
There was the sound of a midnight bang outside the window, and Xia Wuxu slowly loosened his clenched fists. The four crescent-shaped blood stains on his palms were shocking.
In this life-and-death trial, he narrowly defeated half his opponent.
A cold light quietly appeared in the depths of his pupils. Based on the whispers left by the ghost, he vaguely guessed that the person behind the scenes should be the younger brothers who were qualified to inherit the throne of the prince, the second, sixth, or ninth... Xia Wuyang didn't know.
His current strength is low and he has few available people. He doesn't even know who he can trust and how he can find out who is behind it.
The only thing that can be done is to continuously improve the level of cultivation until you have the power to subvert everything. Only then can you understand the truth and find the murderer behind the scenes.
With a little increase in mental strength every day, other attributes will also continue to increase. At this rate, it won't be long before he can do this.
It's almost here! It's almost there!
A sneer crossed Xia Wuyang's lips. He hugged and cherished the newly recruited palace maid Qingdai, and continued to be a dim and incompetent waning prince who played songs every night.
The brocade tent has tassels hanging from it, and the grape wine reflects the fragrance of the lips.
Beauty explains words and smiles, who cares if the night lasts forever.
He was already immersed in it, surrounded by beauties, singing and dancing, as if he didn't know day or night.
Surrounded by some palace maids who were not familiar with spiritual practice, they did not notice at all that underneath this old and withered body, the dragon and tiger's energy and blood are running crazily.
After his improvement and adapting to his body, he was able to continuously improve his cultivation level even without using the Dragon and Tiger Zhuang Kung Fu. Others were unable to do so.
